title: Where Sierra found the people behind a $15B company
summary: Sierra's leaders came from Google, Salesforce, Pinterest, Netflix and OpenAI. Here's where seven of them worked before building a $15B AI customer service company.
body_markdown:
Sierra builds AI agents that handle customer service for large companies. It works with more than 40% of the Fortune 50, and in May 2026 it raised $950M at a $15B valuation, led by GV and Tiger Global.


The company is led by two founders with long careers at the biggest names in tech, and the leaders they've brought in since come from the same kind of places. Here's where seven of them worked before Sierra.
